card.name: Scattered words before a noun
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on varied small words (in, and, with, of, such) and word starts like Ne or h in mixed text.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Short words such as in, and, with or of just before a named condition, title or product.
